title: Unify the presentation foundation
summary: The final 42.0 Night work is consolidated with the strongest grouped-surface ideas from the superseded alternative, removing conflicting overrides without changing roster logic.
changes: Changes now uses a calmer grouped workflow with tighter date, staffing, step, empty-state and history surfaces while keeping the existing save and validation logic unchanged.
Breaks now presents the personal break, summary, schedule and coverage information as clearer grouped surfaces with less competing chrome.
Chat now uses denser inbox, safety, thread and composer spacing so more conversation fits on screen without changing delivery, retention, unread or notification behaviour.

The Night and five-column dock CSS are consolidated: clipping-prone negative margins and superseded finishing overrides are removed, while the validated 360 to 412 pixel Night layout and OLD/NEW clock-change behaviour remain authoritative.
